components.name: Start Button
components.description: Domed lit lamp in the table colour; unlit dark glass when disabled.
components.css: .ds-start { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--table, #ffd23f); color: var(--on-table, #1f1300); font: 800 1rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.45), inset 0 -4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22), 0 3px 0 #343844, 0 6px 14px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); transition: filter 160ms ease-out, transform 90ms ease-out, box-shadow 90ms ease-out; } .ds-start:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-start:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.35), inset 0 -2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.22), 0 1px 0 #343844, 0 3px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-start:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-start:disabled { background: #22143d; color: #b9abd6; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(214 196 255 / 0.3); cursor: default; }

components.name: Chip Button
components.description: Small domed pill for secondary actions on glass.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgb(214 196 255 / 0.3); background: #22143d; color: #f7f1ff; font: 700 0.875rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #c4cad4; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Field glass; the border lights in the table colour on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-field span { font: 700 0.875rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #b9abd6; } .ds-field input { min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid rgb(214 196 255 / 0.3); border-radius: 10px; background: #0f0820; color: #f7f1ff; font: 16px 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; caret-color: #ff8a24; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--table, #ffd23f); outline: none; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: rgb(185 171 214 / 0.75); }

components.name: Dot-Matrix Readout
components.description: Orange plasma Doto on a 0.1em grille: scores, clocks, codes, verdicts. Flashes hurry red in the last five seconds.
components.css: .ds-dmd { display: inline-block; padding: 0.1em 0.3em; border-radius: 6px; font: 800 1.5rem/1.2 'Doto', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ff8a24; background: #140800 radial-gradient(circle, rgb(255 138 36 / 0.16) 0.026em, transparent 0.034em) 0 0.05em / 0.1em 0.1em; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8), 0 0 0 2px #2a2a2e, 0 0 0 3px #6d7380; } .ds-dmd-low { color: #ff5a3c; animation: ds-dmd-flash 1s steps(2, jump-none) infinite; } @keyframes ds-dmd-flash { 50% { color: rgb(255 90 60 / 0.35); } }

components.name: Join Grille
components.description: Code keyed into the dot-matrix inside a chrome bezel, with the JOIN lamp at its end.
components.html: <form class="ds-grille"><input class="ds-code" placeholder="CODE" maxlength="6" aria-label="Game code"><button class="ds-join">Join</button></form>
components.css: .ds-grille { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 10px; border: 7px solid transparent; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(#0c0612, #0c0612) padding-box, linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #e4e8ee 12%, #a7aeba 34%, #4b515d 48%, #f1f3f7 52%, #c3c9d3 70%, #6b7280 90%, #2b2f39 100%) border-box; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #0a0b10, 0 12px 26px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); } .ds-code { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 0.2em 0.3em; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 800 1.9rem/1.2 'Doto', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.3em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ff8a24; caret-color: #ff8a24; background: #140800 radial-gradient(circle, rgb(255 138 36 / 0.16) 0.026em, transparent 0.034em) 0 0.05em / 0.1em 0.1em; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85); } .ds-code::placeholder { color: rgb(255 138 36 / 0.32); } .ds-code:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-join { flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 4.2em; padding: 0 0.6em; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font: 800 1.9rem/1 'Doto', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #2a1200; background: radial-gradient(70% 90% at 50% 40%, #ffd79a 0%, #ffa23f 45%, #d46a10 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 2px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), inset 0 -4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25), 0 3px 8px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 160ms ease-out, transform 90ms ease-out; } .ds-join:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-join:active { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-join:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Arrow Insert
components.description: Playfield arrow for setup choices: hollow lamp off, filled lamp on; focus drawn inside the clip.
components.css: .ds-inserts { display: flex; gap: 4px; --table: #ff8a3d; --on-table: #2a1205; } .ds-insert { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 24px 0 20px; border: 0; clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 14px) 0, 100% 50%, calc(100% - 14px) 100%, 0 100%, 10px 50%); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2f2047 0%, #1d122f 100%); color: #b9abd6; font: 700 0.8125rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease-out, filter 160ms ease-out; } .ds-insert::before { content: ''; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid currentColor; } .ds-insert:hover { color: #f7f1ff; filter: brightness(1.2); } .ds-insert[aria-checked='true'] { background: radial-gradient(80% 140% at 45% 60%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--table) 45%, #fff) 0%, var(--table) 50%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--table) 70%, #000) 100%); color: var(--on-table); } .ds-insert[aria-checked='true']::before { background: currentColor; } .ds-insert:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: -6px; filter: brightness(1.25); }

components.name: Table Lamp
components.description: Hub game picker: a lens lit from inside, dim at rest, full on hover or focus.
components.html: Spin & Solve2–6 players
components.css: .ds-lamp { --lens: #ff4fa3; display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 180px; padding: 6px; color: #f7f1ff; text-decoration: none; text-align: center; border-radius: 24px; } .ds-lens { width: 160px; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-content: center; justify-items: center; gap: 8px; color: #2a0718; background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 62%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--lens) 30%, #fff) 0%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--lens) 62%, #fff) 17%, var(--lens) 45%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--lens) 64%, #000) 76%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--lens) 34%, #000) 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.42), inset 0 0 0 8px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.16), inset 0 -16px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.38), 0 0 0 4px #15101e, 0 0 0 7px #8e95a1, 0 0 0 8px #dfe3ea, 0 14px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.55); filter: brightness(0.86) saturate(0.9); transition: filter 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-lens b { font: 1.2rem/1.05 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; } .ds-lamp small { font: 800 0.92rem 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #ffe7f3; } .ds-lamp:hover .ds-lens, .ds-lamp:focus-visible .ds-lens { filter: none; transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-lamp:active .ds-lens { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-lamp:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Score Plate
components.description: Player name over a DMD score; gold-lit with a filled dot on their turn, dashed when away.
components.css: .ds-plates { display: flex; gap: 10px; list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-plate { display: grid; gap: 6px; justify-items: center; min-width: 132px; padding: 10px 14px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: #170d2b; border: 1px solid rgb(214 196 255 / 0.3); color: #f7f1ff; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, opacity 200ms ease-out; } .ds-plate b { font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-plate span { padding: 0.1em 0.3em; border-radius: 5px; font: 800 1.5rem/1.2 'Doto', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #ff8a24; background: #140800 radial-gradient(circle, rgb(255 138 36 / 0.16) 0.026em, transparent 0.034em) 0 0.05em / 0.1em 0.1em; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.8); } .ds-plate small { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #b9abd6; } .ds-plate.is-turn { border-color: #ffd23f; background: rgb(255 210 63 / 0.14); } .ds-plate.is-turn b::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ffd23f; vertical-align: 1px; } .ds-plate.is-away { opacity: 0.55; border-style: dashed; }

components.name: Setup Apron
components.description: Dark glass panel inside a 6px chrome-ramp bezel.
components.html:
Spin & Solve

Pick a puzzle pack and a game length.
components.css: .ds-apron { padding: 28px; border-radius: 18px; border: 6px solid transparent; background: linear-gradient(#170d2b, #170d2b) padding-box, linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #e4e8ee 12%, #a7aeba 34%, #4b515d 48%, #f1f3f7 52%, #c3c9d3 70%, #6b7280 90%, #2b2f39 100%) border-box; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1), 0 0 0 1px #0a0b10, 0 2px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 14px 34px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); color: #f7f1ff; } .ds-apron h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 1.5rem/1.1 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-apron p { margin: 0; font: 1rem/1.45 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #b9abd6; }

components.name: Jeopardy! Cell
components.description: The show's blue board cell with gold money inside the chrome bezel; kept from the show.
components.css: .ds-board { display: inline-grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 140px); gap: 6px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 14px; border: 6px solid transparent; background: linear-gradient(#020722, #020722) padding-box, linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #e4e8ee 12%, #a7aeba 34%, #4b515d 48%, #f1f3f7 52%, #c3c9d3 70%, #6b7280 90%, #2b2f39 100%) border-box; } .ds-cell { min-height: 72px; padding: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1029a3 0%, #0b1f8c 100%); color: #ffd23f; font: 2rem 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', sans-serif; text-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45); cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; } .ds-cell:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #1430a8; } .ds-cell:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffd23f; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-cell.is-used { background: #071660; color: transparent; text-shadow: none; cursor: default; }

narrative.overview:
Game Night is a pinball cabinet. The shared screen is the backglass: airbrushed art glowing down from the top, rays fanning up from below, the whole screen framed in a chrome bezel. Every score, clock, code and verdict sits on an orange dot-matrix display. Choices are lit playfield inserts: arrows and round lenses that are dark when off and lit in the table's colour when on. Each phone carries the cabinet's domed start and flipper buttons. Each game is its own table, with its own lamp colour and its own backglass art, set on the cabinet's black-violet wood.

The TV and the home hub are where the show happens: chrome lettering, deep glass, lamps that brighten under the cursor. Phones, setup and the host controller are the cabinet's apron: dark glass panels with one obvious lit button at a time. Jeopardy!'s blue-and-gold board and Survey Says!' answer board keep their show looks inside the cabinet's chrome, because each game should still evoke its show.

The system rejects flat, rounded party cards on a purple ground. Depth here comes from physical materials (chrome, glass, lenses, plasma dots), not from floating cards.
keyCharacteristics: Black-violet cabinet ground with a violet glow at the top.
Chrome trim drawn as a stepped metal ramp, used for bezels and display lettering.
One orange dot-matrix display for every score, clock, code and verdict, and nowhere else.
Lamp states (off, lit, flashing) that never rely on colour alone.
Per-game tables that swap one lamp colour and one art colour.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: Plasma orange on a dot grille means "the machine is telling you something": a score, clock, code, round or verdict. Never use Doto or dmd orange for body text, headings or buttons. The one exception is the JOIN lamp, which closes the join strip's code display.

rules.name: The Table Swap Rule
rules.body: A game recolours the cabinet only through `--table`, `--on-table` and `--table-art` on its root. Components read those variables. They never hard-code a game's colour.

rules.name: The Whole-Dot Rule
rules.body: Doto draws on a 0.1em dot grid. Each glyph's dot centres sit half a pitch in from the pen origin and the baseline, with an ascent of 0.95em and a descent of 0.25em. So every readout sets its grille to `background-size: 0.1em 0.1em` at `background-position: 0 0.05em`, uses `line-height: 1.2` and `letter-spacing` in 0.1em steps, pads in 0.1em steps (0.1em 0.3em is standard) and shrink-wraps its box (`inline-block` or `width: fit-content`). Lit dots then land exactly on grille dots. Never centre-stretch a readout or pad it in px.

rules.name: The Chrome Lettering Rule
rules.body: Display type that names the show or a table is chrome: the chrome face clipped into the letters, a 1px art-night stroke, stacked 1px drop steps (#9aa1ad, #5c6270, #2a2e38) for the bevelled edge and a soft shadow underneath, skewed -6° to -7°. Per-game brands swap the face for one built from the table colour.

rules.name: The 720p Rule
rules.body: On TV screens shorter than 800px, the display tightens. Top padding drops to 14px and score plates become one row (name and score side by side). The lobby QR code and code scale with viewport height (24vh, 11vh). Spin & Solve's podiums turn to single rows and its board steps down a size. A whole board plus its scores must fit at 1280×720 without scrolling.

rules.name: The Lit-From-Inside Rule
rules.body: A lit lamp glows through its lens, with a lighter centre and a darker rim. It does not get a halo around it. At rest, hub lenses sit at brightness 0.86. Hover or focus lights them full and lifts them 4px.

rules.name: The Vertical Skirt Rule
rules.body: The only hard-edged offsets are vertical steps directly below an object: the skirt of a domed button and the bevel of chrome lettering. They read as metal thickness. Never offset them sideways.

dos: Do put every score, clock, code, round label and verdict on a dot-matrix readout, sized and padded in whole 0.1em dots with the grille at `0 0.05em`.
Do recolour a game only through `--table`, `--on-table` and `--table-art` on its root.
Do pair every lamp state with a non-colour cue: a hollow versus filled lamp ring, a dashed edge for away or missed, a dot before the active name.
Do frame anything that is the machine (boards, the setup apron, the join strip, the TV edge) in the chrome ramp painted into a transparent border.
Do make unlit states dark glass, not faded colour.
Do draw icons as inline SVG in the table glyphs' stroke (round caps and joins, 2.6–3px on a 24–48 unit box).
Do keep Jeopardy!'s blue-and-gold board and the Survey answer board in their show looks inside the cabinet's chrome.
Do compact the TV layout under 800px tall so a full board and its scores fit at 720p.
donts: Don't use Doto or plasma orange for prose, headings or ordinary buttons.
Don't fake chrome with a flat grey or a single two-stop gradient. Use the ramp with its reflection line.
Don't light a lamp or button with an outer halo. Light it from inside its lens. Show-moment flashes (the Survey strike X, the final countdown) are effects, not lamps, and are exempt.
Don't offset a hard shadow sideways. The only hard steps are vertical skirts and lettering bevels.
Don't let colour alone carry a state, team, or right versus wrong.
Don't fall back to flat rounded party cards floating on a purple ground.
